use: historical reference and offline analysis; not formal comparison

data.requirements_scope: Fifteen phase rows, 317 operators, six ordinary/MTP4 capacity rows, and MTP4/DSpark agentic service. DSpark context boundary is excluded by user instruction.

data.scope: Fifteen absolute phase workload rows. Each selected original is one complete two-warmup, five-measurement set. Parent statuses are retained separately; no samples are combined across attempts. No inference-mode comparison.
data.metric_scope: Phase wall is the maximum request-owned interval per batch. Each median uses five measured values; bound and wall medians are separate. Decode TPS = 4095*batch/median(maximum request decode interval). Theoretical percent = 100*bound_median/wall_median. Prefill spans submitted to first kept token, decode first to last kept token.
limits: This final record composes the two separately SHA-bound independent raw reviews. It does not reparse the original multi-gigabyte rows again. Their actual byte/log/trace/source and per-request checks remain in the two bound reviews.

All seventy-five measured prefill bounds receive exact CPU replay of the canonical model, with only the phase-loop tuple narrowed. This does not repeat the earlier independent mathematical proof or exactly replay full decode models.
Actual native SO and native source/header closures were rehashed in each raw review. Large checkpoint/cache manifests are bound without another full-tree rehash.

Ownership, process-birth, source-stability and final cleanup claims use original supervisor records. No independent GPU/NVML query is made. Arbitrarily short interference between collector polls is not excluded.
Closing worker audits check prohibited modules/libraries, not hashes of every loaded Python code object.
Operator, capacity, service/oh-my-pi and complete-test acceptance are separate. No overall project acceptance is supplied.

limitations: Checks recorded numerical verdicts and complete return/state/cache witness coverage; no GPU numerical replay.
Audits recorded UUID, B200 identity and maximum SM clock; does not query or operate any GPU.

parent_attempt.failure_reason: Retired DSpark batch4 case reported allocator OOM retry; full nine-case collector rejected it.

limitations: This is a six-row derivative from raw logs. It does not turn the failed original nine-case collector into PASS. DSpark capacity data stays in local original failure records and is outside this current six-row data.
Each row is one cold capacity run. Compilation/capture can occur; no steady-state performance, theoretical-bound ratio or statistical stability acceptance is claimed.

Failed parent aggregate JSON is absent. Complete original CLI and before/after checkpoint manifests were not emitted; source identity uses parent frozen-source/binary confirmation and independent actual source/build stamp/provider checks. Target weight payloads are not independently rehashed.

Worker PIDs and temporary IPC paths are absent now, and logs prove graceful worker shutdown/audits. No fresh nvidia-smi measurement or process operation was made; PID birth/ancestry snapshots are unavailable for these original rows.

limitations.fact: OMP proxy preserves complete follow-up request bodies, reply IDs and response_sha256 but omits the complete upstream SSE response body. Tool result bytes, continuation correlation and final answer hash were independently checked.
limitations.limit: The upstream SSE response_sha256 cannot be independently recomputed from an omitted body.

limitations.fact: OMP read results include outline elisions, including in explicit ranges. Required declarations and many real frozen source lines are present, forwarded unchanged and cited by the generated answer.
limitations.limit: The proof concerns genuine selected source reads and follow-up generation, not an unelided read of every source byte. Generated line citations are approximate.

limitations.fact: All four reviewed MTP and DSpark answers identify the project goal, Rust/Python ownership, requested schedule/worker declarations, launch wrappers and source-qualified handoff verification/open work.
limitations.limit: Answers are generated summaries. The test establishes task fulfillment with source use, not an error-free substitute for repository documents.

limitations.fact: Fixed DSpark loader config/weight provenance is checked when that suite closes; the full multi-GB weights are not read again by this reviewer. The service command specifies the target checkpoint, but service artifacts do not include a separate full target checkpoint manifest.

Actual owned native/GEMM .so, CUDA sources, eleven own headers and build-input digests are freshly checked. The recorded pinned CUTLASS/CCCL digest matches the previous full independent tree audit; that installed tree is not rehashed during concurrent phase measurements.
These are startup-fixed HTTP functional suites. This review supplies no throughput, phase-latency, capacity or cross-mode comparison acceptance.
